in_arabic.name: Bajes
in_arabic.long_meaning: Bajes هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'b-j-s', meaning 'to vanquish, to defeat'. This name is mentioned in the Quran in the story of Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) when he defeats his brothers' evil plan to sell him into slavery.
